text: Observe{H8104} the month{H2320} of Abib,{H24} and keep{H6213} the passover{H6453} unto Jehovah{H3068} thy God;{H430} for in the month{H2320} of Abib{H24} Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} brought thee forth{H3318} out of Egypt{H4714} by night.{H3915}

Thou mayest{H3201} not sacrifice{H2076} the passover{H6453} within any{H259} of thy gates,{H8179} which Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} giveth{H5414} thee;

but at the place{H4725} which Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} shall choose,{H977} to cause his name{H8034} to dwell in, there thou shalt sacrifice{H2076} the passover{H6453} at even,{H6153} at the going down{H935} of the sun,{H8121} at the season{H4150} that thou camest forth{H3318} out{H3318} of Egypt.{H4714}

And thou shalt roast{H1310} and eat{H398} it in the place{H4725} which Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} shall choose:{H977} and thou shalt turn{H6437} in the morning,{H1242} and go{H1980} unto thy tents.{H168}

Six{H8337} days{H3117} thou shalt eat{H398} unleavened bread;{H4682} and on the seventh{H7637} day{H3117} shall be a solemn assembly{H6116} to Jehovah{H3068} thy God;{H430} thou shalt do{H6213} no work{H4399} [therein].

Seven{H7651} weeks{H7620} shalt thou number{H5608} unto thee: from the time thou beginnest{H2490} to put the sickle{H2770} to the standing grain{H7054} shalt thou begin{H2490} to number{H5608} seven{H7651} weeks.{H7620}

And thou shalt keep{H6213} the feast{H2282} of weeks{H7620} unto Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} with a tribute{H4530} of a freewill-offering{H5071} of thy hand,{H3027} which thou shalt give,{H5414} according as Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} blesseth{H1288} thee:

And thou shalt remember{H2142} that thou wast a bondman{H5650} in Egypt:{H4714} and thou shalt observe{H8104} and do{H6213} these statutes.{H2706}
Thou shalt keep{H6213} the feast{H2282} of tabernacles{H5521} seven{H7651} days,{H3117} after that thou hast gathered{H622} in from thy threshing-floor{H1637} and from thy winepress:{H3342}

Seven{H7651} days{H3117} shalt thou keep a feast{H2287} unto Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} in the place{H4725} which Jehovah{H3068} shall choose;{H977} because Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} will bless{H1288} thee in all thine increase,{H8393} and in all the work{H4639} of thy hands,{H3027} and thou shalt be altogether joyful.{H8056}

Three{H7969} times{H6471} in a year{H8141} shall all thy males{H2138} appear{H7200} before{H6440} Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} in the place{H4725} which he shall choose:{H977} in the feast{H2282} of unleavened bread,{H4682} and in the feast{H2282} of weeks,{H7620} and in the feast{H2282} of tabernacles;{H5521} and they shall not appear{H7200} before{H6440} Jehovah{H3068} empty:{H7387}

Judges{H8199} and officers{H7860} shalt thou make{H5414} thee in all thy gates,{H8179} which Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} giveth{H5414} thee, according to thy tribes;{H7626} and they shall judge{H8199} the people{H5971} with righteous{H6664} judgment.{H4941}

Thou shalt not wrest{H5186} justice:{H4941} thou shalt not respect{H5234} persons;{H6440} neither shalt thou take{H3947} a bribe;{H7810} for a bribe{H7810} doth blind{H5786} the eyes{H5869} of the wise,{H2450} and pervert{H5557} the words{H1697} of the righteous.{H6662}
That which is altogether{H6664} just{H6664} shalt thou follow,{H7291} that thou mayest live,{H2421} and inherit{H3423} the land{H776} which Jehovah{H3068} thy God{H430} giveth{H5414} thee.
